title: Mixing: Winter Rose by Wings | 1979
content:
Replica Studio, London
Producers: Paul McCartney, Chris Thomas

The song ‘Winter Rose’ was mixed in stereo for Wings’ seventh studio album Back To The Egg on 5 March 1979.

‘Winter Rose’ was recorded on 12 July 1978. Although it was part of a medley with ‘Love Awake’, the two songs were recorded and mixed separately.
